意想不到的損失，一般搭配作“taking a ...”或“took a ... ”

examples.text: Farmer Jones took a hickey on his soybean crop when the flood washed the seeds away.
examples.translation: 洪水把農民瓊斯的種子沖走，使他蒙受損失。
